title: Introducing Muse in the UK: A Personal AI Agent You Control

claims.claim: Meta'nın kişisel yapay zeka ajanı Muse, Birleşik Krallık'ta bugünden itibaren kullanıma sunuldu.

evidence.quote: And from today, Meta’s personal AI agent, which proactively helps with your goals and suggests ideas, is available in the UK.
I've just spent a week using Muse, Meta's AI agent that rolls out in the UK today.

claims.claim: Muse, Meta Superintelligence Labs'ın ilk modeli olan Muse Spark tarafından desteklenmektedir.

evidence.quote: Powered by Muse Spark – the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, built for real-world agentic work — Muse can turn your requests into plans, work through tasks across connected apps and websites, and keep working towards your goal.
Powered by Muse Spark – the first model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, built for real-world agentic work — Muse can turn your requests into plans

claims.claim: Muse ile ödemeler Stripe tarafından geliştirilen Onelink ile veya desteklenen mağazalarda Shopify'ın Shop Pay özelliği ile yapılabilmektedir.

evidence.quote: When it comes time to pay, Muse can checkout with Onelink built by Stripe.

Muse can also checkout with Shop Pay from Shopify with supported stores, which securely uses the payment and shipping details you’ve already saved with Shop Pay, so you can complete your purchase in just a few taps without entering them again.
When it comes time to pay, Muse can checkout with Onelink built by Stripe. Onelink’s wallet for agents generates a unique, digital version of your card that’s only accessible to agents using Onelink.
Muse can also checkout with Shop Pay from Shopify with supported stores, which securely uses the payment and shipping details you’ve already saved with Shop Pay

claims.claim: Meta'nın Birleşik Krallık Ülke Direktörü Shruti Dube, milyonlarca İngiliz'in artık kendi kontrol ettikleri kişisel bir ajana erişebileceğini söyledi.

evidence.quote: Shruti Dube, UK Country Director at Meta: “I’m thrilled that millions of Brits will now have access to a personal agent that they control and that gets things done on their behalf.

claims.claim: PayPal entegrasyonunun yakında Muse deneyimine ekleneceği belirtildi.

evidence.quote: We’re also working to bring more brands into the Muse experience such as PayPal which is coming soon too.

claims.claim: Muse, Birleşik Krallık'ta iOS, Android, muse.ai ve WhatsApp üzerinden 18 yaş ve üzeri herkesin kullanımına sunulmuştur.

evidence.quote: Muse is available to anyone aged 18 and over in the UK from today on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp, and is coming to Meta’s AI glasses in the months ahead.
Muse is available to anyone aged 18 and over in the UK from today on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp
Muse bills itself as a personal AI agent available to anyone aged 18 and over.

claims.claim: Muse uygulamasının önümüzdeki aylarda Meta'nın yapay zeka gözlüklerine de geleceği açıklandı.

evidence.quote: Muse is available to anyone aged 18 and over in the UK from today on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp, and is coming to Meta’s AI glasses in the months ahead.

claims.claim: Muse uygulamasının çoğu kullanım için ücretsiz olduğu, daha fazlasını yapmak isteyenler için ise abonelik planlarının bulunacağı ifade edildi.

evidence.quote: It’s free to use for most of what people need, with subscription plans for those who want to do even more.
Muse is only free to use until a certain point, and then subscriptions kick in.
